book.name: GALATIYA
book.title: Galatiya wali Leta Pol wana Leleli

content: Abapapatini etega na baunan ni ola hiwe. Togogomwau natuna etega, bwagana tamana wana gogomwau abwe ni ahe, ebo iya iyoho ya wana sauga wawaya, iya i ola totuwalali loloyowanina.
He ana tomatahikan, bolo tamana i telel, wali logugui ni toulil, ana siga wana baliman toto tamana i teli ni pwawa.
He i ola te kilau. Valila kila ta ola wawayau bolo wali baliman nige ga i pwapwawa, inoke ta ola totuwalali loloyowanil ge logugui ona bolo ali nuwatu i noek panayawi ya elana ta toulilil.
Yaa ana sauga hot elana toto Yehoba iyaka i teli, inoke Natuna i patuna i nem, i masalem yova etega elana ge i minaa Yudiya wali Logugui gabulanaa.
Yehoba i ginol ola o inoke kilau bolo ta minaa Logugui gabulanaa ni pwamola pasikalila ge ta tabwa iya natunau.
He komiu Yehoba natunau, inoke Natuna Yayaluwana i patuna i nem atemiwa, Yayaluwa o i yogayoga Yehoba elana i ba, “Nam! Nam!”
Inoke nige al nuku oola totuwalali loloyowanil, yaa komiu natunatun. Ge ebo komiu Yehoba natunau, he waisi toto i lovivina-an natunau kaiweliya bwaliga nuku ahe.
Pol I Nuwanuwatu Galatiya kaiweliya
Valila nige Yehoba ku aatena inoke ku tuwalali loloyowan yabowaine kakakawel elal.

Yaa sauga ya Yehoba ku atena, o ebo binimala na ba Yehoba i atenamiu. Inoke ga i ola ge nuku sikalek logugui ona eliyalil ge nuku toulilil, yaa heliya nige wali gasisi ge tage nihi labemiu? Age nuwamiu nuku miloloyowan al eliyalil?
He lan tapwalolo ona ali logugui ku toulil, weikena vavaluna ana logugui ku toulil, hagali ona ali logugui ku toulil, ge baliman vavaluna ana logugui ku toulil.
Inoke ya nuwanuwatu nabi kaiwemiu bahi no tuwalali eliyamiu ni tatabwa bugul bwagabwaga.

Taliwau ge nuwau, ya awanun nabi eliyamiu wami pagan ni ola nau no pagan. Kaiwena sauga valila ya miminaa eliyamiu, Yudiya wali logugui paganina nige ya totoulil, komiu wami pagan te ya ahe. He saugena o ku atupaheyau ge ku ginol bubun eliyau.
Ku atena no kasiyebwa kaiwena te houwan ya nowa wami labiya ge wasa waiwaisana ya papaatena-an eliyamiu.
Yaa bwagana no kasiyebwa o i papulowan-agimiu, nige ku eesaiagau ge ku totowaagau. He ku atupaheyau i ola nau Yehoba wana anelose etega, i ola nau Keliso Yeisu totona.
Saugena o ku yaliyaya bubun kaiweu, yaa sauga ya yaliyaya o ga i noek? Ya ba tunahot, valila nige bugul etega nuku kakaise, yaa wami yaliyaya ana bwata kaiwena bosowaimiu bugul gegewena nuku pem.
He ga i ola? Age nau ami topihigelgel kaiwena ba tunahot ya baunan eliyamiu?

Gamagalau enuna tage wasa waiwaisana nihi pil getogaan. Heliya hi logasisi hot nihi ahemiu, yaa nige ami labe kaiwena i oola. Nuwaliya te nihi teli pwamwaumwau-agimiu eliyama inoke nuku logasisi heliya kaiweliya.
Yaa nau ya logasisi bubun ami labe kaiwena. Ge nige tage sauga ya miminaa eliyamiu ya te ya logasisi, yaa sauga gegewena.
Natuwau nunuwanil, nau ya lolomwan al i ola ab lomwanina, kaiwena nuwau na abimiu nuku ola hot Keliso.
Nuwau hot te binimala sauga ya na kitemiu inoke alowau komiu ta liwaliwan bubun. Kaiwena ya nuwanuwatu nabi kaiwemiu ga na ginol ola ge na labemiu.
Pol I Ba Papatiniek Hega ge Sela elal
Komiu bolo nuwamiu nuku minaa Logugui gabulanaa, nuwau ga na nelimiu, “Tab ku atena Logugui ga i ba ola?”
He Logugui ana buki i ba Abalahama natunau bolau labui, etega yova loloyowanina Hega natuna, ge eluwana yova sokasokalina Sela natuna.
Isimel i masalem yova totuwalali loloyowanina elana, wana masal i ola te kila gegewela wala masal. Yaa Aisake i masalem yova sokasokalina elana kaiwena Yehoba i bateli i ola.

He ba kakanun etega te. Yowau labui ya heliya hi ola bateli labui bolo Yehoba alonau ge gamagalau hi babateli. Bateli etega heiya logugui toto Yehoba i pek Mosese elana oya Sainai elana, ge bateli o natunau heliya hi miloloyowan logugui gabulanaa. He Hega iya i ola bateli toto i neem oya Sainai elana.
Inoke Hega i ola oya Sainai labi Alebiya elana. I ola al bosowaina Hega ta papatini-anek panuwa Yelusalema toto sauga ya, iya alonau ge wana gamagalau hi miloloyowan logugui gabulanaa.
Yaa Sela i ola bateli vavaluna, ge i ola al bosowaina ta papatini-anek Yelusalema toto natiya, iya nige i mimiloloyowan, ge iya kilau toabulilek hinala.
He Aiseya i ba Yelusalema vavaluna natunau nihi gewi, nige ni oola Yelusalema houhouwena. I ba i ola hiwe:

content.text: kobwakobwasina nige sauga etega i aab,
Owa u ola yova toto nige
sauga etega ab lomwanina i gagan elana,
yaa nu wona ge nu loi.
yaa yova toto lagona i mimiavaavan elana, natunau nige nihi gegewi.

content: Taliwau ge nuwau, Yehoba wana bateli kaiwena te Aisake i masal, i ola al Yehoba wana bateli kaiwena te komiu ku tabwa iya natunau.

Sauga houhouwena Abalahama natuna toto wana masal i ola gamagalau gegewela wala masal, talina toto Yehoba Yayaluwana wana gasisi eliyana ge i masal, i papalomwani. He i ola al te sauga ya. Bolo hi minaa Logugui gabulanaa komiu bolo ku masalem Yehoba wana bateli eliyana, hi papalomwan-agimiu.

Yaa waisi toto Yehoba i lovivina-an natunau kaiweliya, heliya nige nihi aahe. He i ola Buki Bwabwalena ana baaba i ba, “Yova totuwalali loloyowanina alona ge natuna nu patuna owaowa-agil. Kaiwena yova totuwalali loloyowanina natuna nige tamana wana gogomwau ni aahe, yova sokasokalina natuna ya te ni ahe.”
Inoke taliwau ge nuwau, kila nige yova toto totuwalali loloyowanina natunau i oola, yaa kila yova toto sokasokalina natunau.
